items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: I remember Earl Anderson was a trumpet player. I know Joe Tillman was a saxophone player. And that's all I can remember.

ctx.x: Yeah. Do you know who the brass band was? Who was it?
I remember Earl Anderson was a trumpet player. I know Joe Tillman was a saxophone player. And that's all I can remember.
